method: Qualitative inspection by Codex of each saved validated synthetic response; not a real cooked-meal evaluation.
stateChecks: Structural fixture checks: accepted flow, expected servings/unused quantities or omission, unchanged current step/completion IDs, and immutable completed instructions/used ingredient values. These do not prove prose ingredient accounting or adequacy of portions.
